description: This Java source file defines the CachingClientFactory class, which extends ClientFactory. It manages creation, caching, and retrieval of client instances with retry and concurrency control, using Vertx for asynchronous operations. It includes methods for removing clients, clearing cache, and getting or creating clients with liveness checks.

classes.name: CachingClientFactory
classes.description: A generic factory class for creating, caching, and managing client instances with concurrency and retry logic, using Vertx for asynchronous operations.
